resources.string: Offer fallback translation on comment long press

Off by default. Long-press a comment with text and choose manual translation to send it to TikTok’s online service. Switch original/translation/bilingual or retry failed segments; full native actions remain accessible. No offline or persistent cache is added.
Only the comment you select is submitted through TikTok’s translation channel. Failed segments retain their source text. Closing cancels further requests; no persistent cache is saved here.
%1$d segments could not be translated. Their original text is retained; retry is available.
Finished. Content without a different translation retains the original text.
